title.zh: 将马林杜克省托里霍斯市镇蒂格维村的凯波、纳比林、卡哈瓦南、阿帕塔汉与卡林派小村组建为名为卡瓦亚南村的独立村的法案
title.en: An Act Constituting the Sitios of Kay-Poo, Nabiling, Kahawanan, Apartahan and Kalimpay in the Barrio of Tigwi, Municipality of Torrijos, Province of Marinduque, into a Separate Barrio to be Known as the Barrio of Kawayanan
title.orig: An Act Constituting the Sitios of Kay-Poo, Nabiling, Kahawanan, Apartahan and Kalimpay in the Barrio of Tigwi, Municipality of Torrijos, Province of Marinduque, into a Separate Barrio to be Known as the Barrio of Kawayanan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2581_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitios of Kay-Poo, Nabiling, Kahawanan, Apartahan and Kalimpay in the barrio of Tigwi, Municipality of Torrijos, Province of Marinduque, are hereby constituted into a separate barrio of the said municipality to be known as the barrio of Kawayanan.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1959.
